title: My Trip to Brazil! 🇧🇷 -- SLOW English Podcast for High Beginners! A2-B1 (comprehensible input)

header.titleZh: 我的巴西之旅！ 🇧🇷 -- 適合高級初學者的慢速英語播客！ A2-B1（可理解的輸入）
header.titleEn: My Trip to Brazil! 🇧🇷 -- SLOW English Podcast for High Beginners! A2-B1 (comprehensible input)

sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客。

sentences.en: Today I want to talk to you about my trip to Brazil all in a slow comprehensible and clear way with videos and pictures.
sentences.tc: 今天我想透過影片和圖片，以緩慢易懂且清晰的方式向您講述我的巴西之行。

sentences.en: You can understand and learn English faster try not to read the subtitles and just listen.
sentences.tc: 你可以更快地理解和學習英語，盡量不要看字幕，只聽。

sentences.en: Then repeat by shadowing second my trip to Brazil was so much fun.
sentences.tc: 然後透過追蹤第二次重複我的巴西之旅非常有趣。

sentences.en: I started my day around 4 a.m. I had to catch the 5 a.m. bus to the airport my flight took off at 9 a.m.
sentences.tc: 我早上 4 點左右開始新的一天。我必須趕早上 5 點的巴士去機場，我的航班早上 9 點起飛。

sentences.en: I like to be at the airport at least 2 hours before my flight just in case.
sentences.tc: 我喜歡在航班起飛前至少 2 小時到達機場，以防萬一。

sentences.en: I arrived at the airport around 7 a.m. and I was feeling a bit hungry.
sentences.tc: 早上7點左右到達機場，感覺有點餓了。

sentences.en: I ate my Greek yogurt but I forgot my spoon so I had to use my yogurt lid to scoop all the yogurt out instead.
sentences.tc: 我吃了希臘酸奶，但我忘了帶勺子，所以我不得不用酸奶蓋把所有酸奶舀出來。

sentences.en: After finishing my Greek yogurt I was all ready to go through the security checkpoint.
sentences.tc: 喝完希臘優格後，我就準備好通過安檢了。

sentences.en: I put all my electronics on a tray and I took off my sweater and my hat once.
sentences.tc: 我把所有的電子產品放在一個托盤上，然後脫掉了毛衣和帽子。

sentences.en: I got through the security checkpoint I found my gate number I sat.
sentences.tc: 這裡是在描述日常生活，可以把重點放在整句的主詞和動作。

sentences.en: I waited for boarding to begin once boarding started I sat in my seat with my headphones and some music.
sentences.tc: 登機開始後，我戴著耳機，聽著音樂，坐在座位上等待登機。

sentences.tc: 我喜歡在飛機起飛時聽音樂，我也喜歡在飛行途中看電影，我在第四班機上吃了一塊草莓餅乾。

sentences.en: Finally arrived in Panama for my layover I boarded my.
sentences.tc: 終於抵達巴拿馬進行中途停留，我登上了我的航班。

sentences.en: Next flight that would take me straight to Rio de janeo and 7 hours later I was in Brazil but my legs hurt so much.
sentences.tc: 下一趟航班將直接帶我飛往裡約熱內盧，7 小時後我到達了巴西，但我的腿很痛。

sentences.en: They were so cramp and rigid from being sat for 7 hours.
sentences.tc: 由於坐了 7 個小時，他們變得非常抽筋和僵硬。

sentences.en: I usually like to stretch as much as I can when I have long flights.
sentences.tc: 當我乘坐長途航班時，我通常喜歡盡可能多地伸展身體。

sentences.en: Do you think it's important to stretch in between flight what helps?
sentences.tc: 您認為在飛行途中做伸展運動很重要嗎？有什麼幫助嗎？

sentences.en: You get through long flights does music help you movies sleep maybe.
sentences.tc: 當你度過長途飛行時，聽電影也許可以幫助你入睡。

sentences.en: When I arrived at the airport it was 1 a.m. 1:00 at night and it's never a good idea to arrive in a new city at 1 a.m. but for me it?

sentences.en: She pointed me in the right direction.

sentences.en: Then I took a 30 minute Uber ride.
sentences.tc: 然後我搭乘了 30 分鐘的優步。

sentences.en: Finally arrived at my hostel on kopa Cabana Beach I dropped all all of my bags all of my luggage all of it in my room.
